name: Bandwagon 5 (Dedicated Mid-Inclination Rideshare)
slot_a_text: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
slot_b_text: B1085 has eighteen flights behind it, in almost two years. The mix: ten Starlink, one Crew, one GPS, and six others. At its fastest it was back on the pad in 23 days.
description: Dedicated rideshare flight to a mid-inclination orbit with dozens of small microsatellites and nanosatellites for commercial and government customers.
rocket_fact: Pogo oscillation is a coupled vibration between a rocket's propulsion system and its structure that can become dangerously unstable.
